title: A Winter for the Room
author: Isandro Eastwick
blurb: Ines Galloway, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
